correctness.rationale: Independent differentiation of \(\log F=\log eta+\log S+\log V-\log N-U/N\) reproduces exactly the six incidence derivatives stated in the claim. In particular \(F_R=FC\) is generically nonzero, so the printed \(\dot\lambda_6=\mu\lambda_6\) is not the Hamiltonian gradient. Separately, the Hamiltonian quarantine flows \(-u_3S\) and \(+u_3S\) force \((\lambda_1-\lambda_2)u_3\). The primary full text confirms both incompatible printed terms.
